### Audit Summary
The findings and recommended refactorings have been written to [`02_REVIEW.md`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_grep_arm_b_i4bp7e8h/02_REVIEW.md):

1. **Specification & Flag Compliance:**
   - [`grep`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_grep_arm_b_i4bp7e8h/grep.py#L1-L45) satisfies the core requirements for fixed-string search (no regex) across files in order.
   - Flag interactions and precedence (`-l` suppressing `-n`, `-x -v` filtering, `-n` positioning after `filename:`) are correctly ordered.
2. **Edge Cases & Algorithmic Flaws:**
   - **Unicode Case Folding:** [`grep.py`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_grep_arm_b_i4bp7e8h/grep.py#L13-L21) uses `.lower()` instead of `.casefold()`, which fails for Unicode characters with asymmetrical casing (e.g., German `ß` vs `SS`, Greek sigmas).
   - **`flags` Argument Typing:** `flags.split()` assumes a string and fails with `AttributeError` if `flags` is passed as a list/tuple (common in CLI/JSON fixtures) or `None`.
   - **Line Ending Stripping:** `rstrip("\r\n")` strips all consecutive trailing carriage returns/newlines rather than stripping at most a single trailing newline sequence.
   - **File Encoding:** `open(filename)` lacks explicit `encoding="utf-8"`, risking platform-dependent decoding issues on non-UTF-8 defaults.
3. **Performance Traps:**
   - Constructing records in 3 sequential string formatting steps (`content + "\n"`, `f"{line_number}:{record}"`, `f"{filename}:{record}"`) causes unnecessary intermediate string allocations per matched line.
   - Lowercasing/casefolding on every line inside the inner loop can be short-circuited when string lengths cannot satisfy exact or substring criteria.

See [`02_REVIEW.md`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_grep_arm_b_i4bp7e8h/02_REVIEW.md) for full audit details and the proposed refactored implementation. No changes were made to [`grep.py`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_grep_arm_b_i4bp7e8h/grep.py) or test files.
